title: For customers who paid more than 20.00 per unit for product ID 5, calculate
question: For customers who paid more than 20.00 per unit for product ID 5, calculate the percentage increase in their total annual consumption from 2012 to 2013, broken down by customer segment (SME, LAM, KAM). Only include segments where such customers exist and have consumption records in both years.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE t.XCL_016 = 5
      AND CAST(t.XCL_018 AS REAL) / t.XCL_017 > 20.00
),
annual_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_001 IN (SELECT XCL_001 FROM qualifying_customers)
      AND SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    CAST((SUM(consumption_2013) - SUM(consumption_2012)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(consumption_2012) AS percentage_increase
FROM annual_consumption
GROUP BY segment
